audit_metadata.scope: Complete system review - 225 source files, 16000+ LOC, 255 test files

critical_issues.title: CircuitBreaker State Machine Incomplete Refactoring
critical_issues.failure_scenario: recordFailure() method references this.successCount and this.failureCount which no longer exist. Will throw TypeError when circuit breaker fails.
critical_issues.impact: Circuit breaker becomes unusable; request throttling fails; all retry logic affected
critical_issues.fix_complexity: Simple - delete dead code, fix property access
critical_issues.risk: HIGH - affects retry logic throughout system

critical_issues.title: CircuitBreaker Return Type Mismatch
critical_issues.failure_scenario: getState() declares return type 'CLOSED' | 'OPEN' | 'HALF_OPEN' but returns CircuitBreakerState object. Code like if (breaker.getState() === 'OPEN') always evaluates false.
critical_issues.impact: State checks fail silently; state machine logic breaks down
critical_issues.fix_complexity: Simple - return this.state.status instead of this.state
critical_issues.risk: HIGH - silent failures in state checking

critical_issues.title: CircuitBreaker Dead Code with Conflicting Logic
critical_issues.failure_scenario: After valid state transitions (lines 457-474), execution continues to lines 476-480 with old conflicting logic that mutates state incorrectly
critical_issues.impact: State corruption after valid transitions; unpredictable behavior

critical_issues.title: CircuitBreaker Property Access on Uninitialized Field
critical_issues.failure_scenario: Code references this.failureCount directly but should use this.state.failureCount based on new object structure
critical_issues.fix_complexity: Simple - update property references to use this.state object
critical_issues.risk: HIGH - runtime crash on failure path

high_priority_issues.title: UUID Generation Type Check Redundancy
high_priority_issues.failure_scenario: Double type checking after truthy operator is redundant defensive programming
high_priority_issues.impact: Low - try/catch prevents failure, but indicates over-engineering

high_priority_issues.title: Logger Fallback Dependency
high_priority_issues.failure_scenario: logFileCorruption uses logger without explicit null-check. Fallback logger loses structured context
high_priority_issues.impact: Error messages lose context during corruption events
high_priority_issues.fix_complexity: Simple - add explicit null-check and fallback

high_priority_issues.title: Token Timestamp Validation Gap
high_priority_issues.failure_scenario: isValidTokenPayload validates iat < exp but not iat >= 0 or iat <= now(). Future-dated tokens can pass validation
high_priority_issues.impact: Tokens with future iat values pass validation, allowing timing attacks

rate_limiting.coverage: Auth, meetings, metrics, all public APIs

no_findings.sql_injection: ✅ CLEAN - No string concatenation patterns found
no_findings.hardcoded_secrets: ✅ CLEAN - Grep found 0 hardcoded API keys
no_findings.missing_auth: ✅ CLEAN - All protected routes enforce JWT
no_findings.console_logs: ✅ MOSTLY CLEAN - Only in examples/scripts, not core code

items: Replace all direct property access with this.state.*
Add iat >= 0 and iat <= now() validation
Add automated secret scanning to CI/CD
